page.text:
A Dedekind cut is a nonempty proper lower subset of the rationals with no
greatest element. Every Cauchy-real class determines the cut of rationals
lying strictly below its limit. The canonical correspondence is
bijective, so the Cauchy operations above can be transported across it to
give the cut carrier the same complete ordered-field structure.
